questions.e: In the video: "Počela grejna sezona u Beogradu" — the heating season has started in Belgrade.
In the video: "uz nepromenjene cene toplotne energije" — with unchanged heat prices.

questions.q: How will 60 out of 100 apartments be billed?
questions.e: In the video: "60 od 100 stanova prelazi na obračun po stvarnoj potrošnji umesto po kvadratu" — 60 out of 100 apartments switch to billing by actual consumption instead of by square metres.

questions.q: When does the system automatically switch off the heating?
o: When it is above 15 degrees outside
questions.e: In the video: "automatski gasi grejanje kada spoljna temperatura pređe 15 stepeni" — automatically switches off the heating when the outside temperature goes above 15 degrees.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: ali 60 od 100 stanova *prelazi* na obračun po stvarnoj potrošnji
questions.e: Prelaziti — to cross over, switch (to another system).
Ušteda — saving; radi uštede — for the sake of saving.

questions.q: što građanima omogućava manje *račune* ukoliko štede energiju
questions.e: Račun — a bill; račune — acc. pl.
Sezona is feminine nominative: grejna sezona.
Cene (of what?) energije — genitive fem.: toplotne energije.
The preposition po ("by") here takes the dative/locative: po stvarnoj potrošnji.

questions.q: dok pri ___ od nule i nižim radijatori greju
questions.e: The preposition pri ("at, during") takes the locative: pri temperaturama.
